verdict.rationale: IRCC documents a sanctioned representative rail: there are representative accounts alongside employer accounts (ircc-docs-8), and a public check of whether a representative is authorized, with a way to report fraud or abuse (ircc-docs-13). However, the evidence consists only of navigation-level mentions. Nothing shows how a representative is designated to act for a company, or what they may do on its behalf. missing for 10: documentation of how representatives or designees are appointed for an employer, the scope of their authority to act for a company, any detail beyond homepage link text, and independent corroboration.
